readme.title: Project: 1000 — 1000 Things Before I Die
readme.summary: A private, offline bucket list and memory journal for Android and iOS.
headings: Backup, restore and moving to a new phone
features: Starts empty. The list contains only what you write. There are no sample items or suggestions.
Up to 1,000 items, each with a permanent number (#001 … #1000).
Your order is never changed by the app. Completing, editing, searching or filtering never moves an item. Order changes only when you reorder (drag, arrows, or "move to place…").
Completion with dates. Choose the day you did it, past dates included. Un-completing keeps the old date on record.
Memories: any number per item, each with optional title, text, date, location, hashtags and multiple photos.
Photos are stored privately inside the app, with thumbnails and a full-screen swipe/zoom viewer.
Search across numbers, titles, descriptions, memory text, locations and #hashtags; filters for All / Completed / Not completed.
Progress: completed, remaining and percentage of 1,000.

Profile, EXP and levels. Every completed thing is worth exactly 1,000 EXP and every 10 things is a level, up to Level 100 at 1,000 / 1,000. It is always calculated from the list, never stored or granted any other way, and it never affects the order.
Journeys. Finishing all 1,000 things completes a journey. You choose when to archive it and begin the next (reusing your list or starting fresh). Every archived journey is kept in full, read-only.
Life Album for each journey: your completed things and memories as a book, in your list's order, exportable as a PDF.
Backup & restore to a single .zip file for moving to a new phone. Every file is checksum-verified before anything is replaced.
Light, dark or system theme.

readme.title: Consulta
readme.summary: Academic consultation booking system for Mapúa University SOIT. Students book consultation slots with professors. Professors manage schedules and log outcomes. Admins monitor all activity.
features: Browse professor availability and book consultation slots
Choose date, time, mode (Face-to-Face / Online), and nature of concern
View, cancel, and track consultation history grouped by quarter
Download blank advising slip template; upload signed form after session
Password reset — request a reset link via email; set a new password via token
Home page — current academic week, term progress, countdown to finals
Help Center — usage guide, submission guidelines, expandable FAQs
Chatbot — full FAQ widget powered by Claude API; answers questions about professors, booking steps, policies, and concern types
My Consultations — confirm (with optional meeting link for Online), complete (action taken, referral, remarks), or reschedule bookings
Manage Schedules — create slots with multiple time ranges per date, set location
Export Report — PDF or Excel report filtered by period (week / semester / year)
History — past sessions grouped by quarter
Home and Help Center accessible from sidebar
View all consultations with stats (total / pending / confirmed / completed / cancelled)
User management: approve, reject, deactivate/reactivate, create, delete accounts
Promote/demote professors to/from admin (max 2 admins enforced)
